about: Each walk backs a "cheapest" or "no ... under budget" claim. It starts from Airbnb's search with the washer filter for the stay (two adults, totals before tax in US dollars, read 9 Nov 2026), keeps the listings in the stated area, and goes up in the search's price order: a listing is the pick when its own page puts the washer in the unit and offers free cancellation (a date, not 24 hours) and its total plus tax is within the budget; the walk ends at the budget line when the next total plus tax passes it. Each step says where its washer and refund facts come from. The 9 Nov scripted washer reads are retired and their wording was not kept; everything read on the listing page itself is in data/checks.
